title: A tool result's image, audio, blob resource and resource link read as one-line notes naming their kind and media type: the type kept to the characters a media type has, at most 64, and for a type the server did not name image/png, audio, binary or unknown
notes: Python: tools/_mcp_result.py _text_of and _note (_MEDIA_TYPE_CHARS, _MEDIA_TYPE_LIMIT); roomkit-rs: roomkit-mcp texts.rs. The public text-returning call_tool reads every non-text content as its note, an image of a type the model takes included, the contents several, so a JSON array of their texts. An image or an audio whose server named no type sends an empty mimeType, which the protocol requires. Not observed: a kind of content the protocol does not define, which the client refuses before the note is written.
